name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments
description: PM-KISAN is a 100% centrally-funded sector scheme providing direct financial assistance to all landholding farmer families across India for agricultural inputs and domestic needs.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health
benefit: Cashless health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
description: The world's largest government-financed healthcare scheme, providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover across 27,000+ empanelled hospitals.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakhs on home loans
description: A mission providing pucca houses to eligible urban families belonging to EWS/LIG categories with civic amenities like water, sanitation, and electricity.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
benefit: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh in plains, ₹1.30 Lakh in hilly states
description: Assistance for construction of pucca houses for all houseless rural families and those living in dilapidated houses based on SECC 2011 criteria.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
benefit: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000
description: A social security scheme for all Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years, focusing on workers in the unorganized sector to secure guaranteed pensions after age 60.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (Ujjwala 2.0)
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefit: Free LPG gas connection, first refill & stove with ₹1,600 subsidy
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to adult women from poor households to safeguard family health from hazardous biomass smoke.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Ministry of Finance
benefit: High government-backed compound interest (8.2% p.a.) with tax exemption
description: A 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' savings scheme empowering parents of girl children under 10 to build an education and marriage corpus under Section 80C tax benefits.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
department: Department of Financial Services
benefit: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 Lakhs (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun)
description: Provides micro-finance loans to non-corporate, non-farm small enterprises for business expansion, technology adoption, and equipment purchase.

name: PM Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman Yojana
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit: Skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 tool grant & collateral-free loans up to ₹3 Lakhs at 5%
description: Holistic support scheme providing end-to-end assistance to traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 family-based trades.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit: Micro-credit working capital loans up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy
description: Special micro-credit facility empowering urban and peri-urban street vendors to resume livelihoods through formal banking capital.

name: Central Sector Post-Matric Scholarship for Higher Education
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: Full college tuition reimbursement plus ₹1,200/month maintenance stipend
description: Financial assistance for meritorious students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary courses in recognized universities and colleges.

name: PM Vidyalaksmi Education Loan Scheme
department: Ministry of Education
benefit: Collateral-free educational loans up to ₹7.5 Lakhs with 3% interest subsidy
description: Single-window electronic platform for students seeking educational loans from public sector banks for admission into NIRF top-ranked institutions.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
benefit: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per financial year at statutory wages
description: Legal social security right guaranteeing at least 100 days of unskilled manual wage employment to every rural household whose adult members volunteer.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefit: Subsidized agricultural credit at effective 4% interest rate up to ₹3,00,000
description: Provides timely short-term credit to farmers for crop production, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing, and maintenance of farm assets.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Comprehensive crop loss insurance with low farmer premium (1.5% - 2%)
description: Financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising from unforeseen weather events, pests, and natural calamities.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit: Cash assistance of ₹1,400 (Rural) and ₹1,000 (Urban) for institutional delivery
description: Safe motherhood intervention scheme promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) & Swavlamban Welfare
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
benefit: National disability identity card unlocking pan-India travel, scholarship, and assistive aid benefits
description: Creating a national database for PwDs and issuing a Disability Certificate with smart ID card to ensure seamless welfare delivery across states.

name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya (Chiranjeevi) Yojana
department: Department of Medical, Health & Family Welfare
benefit: Cashless health treatment up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year
description: Universal health insurance covering all families in Rajasthan for cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization in empanelled hospitals.

name: Rajasthan Jan Aadhaar Yojana
department: Planning Department, Government of Rajasthan
benefit: Single family ID card for direct benefit transfer of 100+ state services
description: 'One Number, One Card, One Identity' scheme for all resident families of Rajasthan with the woman recognized as the head of the family.

name: Mukhyamantri Anuprati Coaching Yojana
department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department
benefit: Free competitive exam coaching (UPSC, NEET, JEE, RAS) plus ₹40,000 hostel stipend
description: Provides free coaching assistance to economically disadvantaged students belonging to SC, ST, OBC, MBC, EWS, and minority categories.

name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
department: Department of Women and Child Development
benefit: Direct milestone deposits up to ₹100,000 in SBI accrued until age 18
description: Enhances the social status of girl children in NCT of Delhi by providing periodic financial deposits at key school milestones.

name: Jai Bheem Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana
department: Department for Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/Minorities
benefit: 100% free coaching for civil services/engineering/medical + ₹2,500/month stipend
description: Empowers talented underprivileged students of Delhi with elite coaching for national entrance exams through empanelled institutes.

name: MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
department: Department of Higher and Technical Education
benefit: 100% tuition and exam fee waiver for undergraduate and diploma courses
description: Centralized scholarship portal for students belonging to backward classes and economically weaker sections in Maharashtra.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
department: Women Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh
benefit: Conditional cash transfer of ₹25,000 in 6 installment stages
description: Promotes healthcare and higher education for girl children in Uttar Pradesh through phased monetary grants from birth to graduation.

name: Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana
department: Social Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh
benefit: Free high-quality offline & virtual coaching for competitive exams + free tablets
description: Coaching by serving IAS/IPS officers and subject experts for UPSC, UPPSC, JEE, NEET, and CDS aspirants residing in Uttar Pradesh.
